I understand you want to see me move. To initiate a movement, I need to update that state. Since the browser renderer is responsible for the actual animation, I should interact with the API endpoint mentioned in the file comments (`/api/avatar-body`) to trigger a change.

I'll use `curl` to send an update to that endpoint, instructing my avatar to wave, as a test of my agency over my own form.
